_note: Per-symbol version of market_regime.json: blocks ENTRY if the stock's own sector benchmark isn't trending up. Needs config/sector_map.json populated (scripts/build_universe.py - it writes this file on every run, no extra flag needed) and industry_to_benchmark filled in below with real instrument keys added to config/universe.json (already done - map below is populated, not empty). Flipped to enabled on 2026-10-26: it's part of both weekly_rsi_sma20's (Run 7) and pullback_ma's winning combos per the tune_strategy.py --mode smart sweep. Scoring went through two iterations on 2026-10-27 to fix a real regression (pullback_ma, whose only scoring filter is this one, winning nearly every slot contest against strategies using the now-continuous rs_rank/trend_strength - see trader/filters/sector_regime.py's class docstring for the full story). The first attempt (a fixed score_ceiling_pct) was tested with a real 3-month backtest and did NOT work - a fixed absolute ceiling is regime-dependent. Current approach: a cross-sectional PERCENTILE of each industry's benchmark-distance against every other industry's, computed fresh each day in prepare() - no ceiling config needed, it self-calibrates. The pass/fail gate itself (buffer_pct) is unaffected.
